stories.title: North Wales Police issues warning over invoice fraud targeting businesses and schools
stories.summary: North Wales Police is warning businesses, schools and individuals to be on guard against invoice fraud, which it describes as one of the most common and costly forms of financial crime. stories.title: Thousands of children and teenagers turned to Childline over loneliness last year
stories.summary: A growing number of children and young people are reaching out to Childline for help as they struggle with loneliness and isolations. In the past 12 months the NSPCC-run service delivered 4,893, counselling sessions – an annual increase of seven per cent – to youngsters seeking support with loneliness. stories.title: Armed Forces and Emergency Services Day added to Mold’s Sunday market this weekend
stories.summary: The Sunday Gathering Artisan Market returns to Mold town centre this Sunday with an Armed Forces and Emergency Services Day bringing together military and blue light organisations from across north Wales. stories.title: Mold primary school wins Welsh climate award for waste reduction work
stories.summary: A primary school in Mold has won a national climate award after its pupils researched ways to cut waste across their school and local community. stories.title: Flintshire residents asked to have their say on county-wide dog and alcohol orders
stories.summary: County-wide orders to prevent anti-social behaviour involving dogs or alcohol have been opened up to consultation by Flintshire County Council.
